title: Rate and credit betas by sector (partial pooling)
description: Each sector's sensitivity of monthly stock returns to 10Y yield and Baa credit-spread changes, shrunk toward the market-wide sensitivity.
question: macro
method_note: Stock-month panel with sector-varying intercepts and slopes on the two macro shocks (same for every stock in a month). Partial pooling regularizes sectors with few names (UTIL, ENRG). Expect positive rate betas for FINS, negative for REAL / UTIL, negative credit betas everywhere. Caveat: the universe is today's constituents (membership history starts 2026-10), so early years carry survivorship bias; read the premium as an upper bound.

result.verdict: partial pooling beats linear-Gaussian baseline on CRPS (DM p = 2.44e-07); point forecast: partial pooling beats linear baseline (DM p = 0.000104)
